scope: 原46篇与独立Axis44条目，合并为81个不同arXiv ID；新增主题检索独立记录，不伪造种子引用。

agentic_existing.scope: 原46篇文献的实验场景审计；没有修改旧库/Excel/Doc。优先复用已核正文证据，对agentic边界含糊的ID4/19/22/26/29/33/41重新查官方正文。

tag_semantics.single-turn: 关键评价包括给定prompt/历史后的独立一次回答或选项概率；可能包含训练或长CoT，均不自动构成长程agent。
tag_semantics.multi-turn-dialogue: 多轮交互或固定多轮脚本/历史被用于训练、观测或评价；setting_summary进一步说明用途，不默认在线闭环。
tag_semantics.long-context/long-horizon: 论文明确研究many-shot/长对话或生产长轨迹；摘要说明长输入还是闭环长程，不能由此推断两者等价。
tag_semantics.agentic-tool-execution: 实验或观测语料有模型实际调用执行的工具/环境反馈；不表示被steer的一定是行动agent，也不表示已验证长horizon。
tag_semantics.multi-agent-interaction: 研究任务里有独立角色actor的互动，例如用户模拟器与工具agent；不把单模型CoT内的拟人对话计作真实多agent。
tag_semantics.training-only: 只有训练期现象且没有对应运行时/生成评价才使用；本批没有整篇符合者。

direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.title: Emotion Concepts and their Function in a Large Language Model
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.finding: 从故事文本提取的desperate/calm情绪方向实际注入Claude Sonnet4.5，在不可能单测的coding闭环改变reward-hacking率；测试失败/代码修改/再测构成环境反馈。高强度anger与黑mail策略还可能非单调。
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.what_it_establishes: 对话/故事相关内部情绪概念可以迁移到agent执行倾向；表面不显情绪时仍可改行为。
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.what_it_does_not_establish: 没有证明任意Big-Five/role persona向量都能跨agent任务稳定迁移；没有完整planner-action表示比较或人格subspace机制定位。

direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.title: How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents: A Mechanistic Study
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.finding: E-STEER在SAE VAD特征上构造干预，agent由planner/decider/executor组成；正文明确executor使用工具或LLM分析，含重规划、执行置信度和完成率，HotpotQA/Scientific/GAIA作为任务源。
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.what_it_establishes: 已比较情绪内部干预在计划、决策、执行阶段的不同收益曲线，并报告系统级成功率；不是仅对文本语气评分。
direct_internal_emotion_interventions_on.what_it_does_not_establish: 未比较分别从planning/action/feedback trace提取的方向，也未证明conversational persona vector的跨任务agentic迁移；实际工具清单与统一horizon深度仍需代码级核查。

external_user_persona_pressure_on_tool_a.finding: TraitBasis从配对对话提取impatience/skepticism/confusion/incoherence向量，steer的是用户模拟器。τ-Trait中的被测agent通过真实工具访问/更改数据库；BFCL分支则主要AST匹配函数输出，不能把所有部分都称环境执行。
external_user_persona_pressure_on_tool_a.distinction: 可控用户反馈影响agent成功率，尚未将persona方向写入被测agent。

agent_context_or_identity_without_full_t.finding: 生产级coding工具轨迹提供真实长horizon语料；核心是snapshot-then-probe与register/格式评价。App.O局部Axis steering恢复投影却不恢复行为judge；不是已证明全程agent persona控制成功。
持久Claude Code/OpenClaw身份漂移由system anchor在resume时丢失触发；重复heartbeat和身份probe有因果控制。核心实验没有工具完成率或内部vector，不能因为harness叫agent就归为agentic-vector验证。
Assistant Axis研究模拟多轮对话和身份/安全capping，包括coding对话对照；不是长程工具任务的可靠性验证。

tool_agent_in_the_evaluation_but_not_the.finding: AuditBench调查agent使用白盒/黑盒工具调查模型；honesty steering作用于被审计目标，tool-to-agent gap是诊断工具未转成调查收益。
Interpretability agent用模型查询和激活差读出识别finetuning目标；方向用于目标模型/文本，未steer调查agent长期persona。

generic_reasoning_and_control_related_bu.finding: SAE conversation-related feature改善Countdown和RL推理；societies of thought是单模型trace结构，不是真实多个agent或工具环境。
FPCG从CoT句边界读未来行为概率来筛选续写；它是候选生成+readout决策，不沿probe权重直接写activation，也无live tool-action轨迹。
generic_reasoning_and_control_related_bu.location: future behavior trajectories；FPCG方法与六行为实验

generic_reasoning_and_control_related_bu.finding: 博弈题金额/二元选项是独立描述性决策，不是两模型完整对局。
CCT/BART所谓behavior读取合法答案token likelihood，不能据此声称风险agent执行控制。
search_info实验追加预置正确建议，评价仅字符串检测是否调用；没有真实检索行动闭环。
RoleAgentBench使用固定script和角色多选准确率，不能凭Agent名称认定工具/多agent系统控制。

agentic_existing.research_gap_inference: 原库已存在情绪方向→工具agent行为的直接实验（4、29），所以不能声称agentic steering从未做过。更具体尚可检验的是：self-report/role/conversational trait方向与trace-derived行为方向是否共享可因果迁移的子空间；这种迁移在planning、tool selection、environment feedback及长horizon中是否保持选择性、coherence和任务性能。19是外部压力源，38/41是长期上下文与harness控制变量；11/27提供trace读出与控制方法而非同一问题的现成答案。

agentic_search.scope: 针对persona/role/trait activation steering向真实agent与长期交互迁移的定向查漏；不是系统性穷尽检索。只写/tmp，未增改旧库。
queries: "Activation-Steered Personas in Task-Oriented LLM Agent Simulations"

new_direct_evidence.title: Mind Your Own Role: Reducing Role Overstepping for Effective and Efficient Multi-Agent Collaboration via Dynamic Role Activation Steering
new_direct_evidence.task_endpoints: ChatDev/MetaGPT完成SRDD1200软件需求：role-overstepping judge、角色embedding一致性、无placeholder、实际可编译/运行比例、需求code embedding一致性、time/tokens。SWE-Dev只作离线向量/probe准备和validation，不是主test。
new_direct_evidence.intervention: 每role同一subtask context有/无role instruction的末tokenresidual差平均构造固定role vector；用有/无越界trajectory末token训练linear detector，decode每token加α*p(overstep)*v；role instructions仍保留。
new_direct_evidence.models: Qwen2.5-7B与Llama3.1-8B；共享模型内层/强度，validation选层（例如Qwen18）
new_direct_evidence.scope_and_limits: 确有role activation用于运行中多agent软件流程；quality是三个proxy平均，不是严格功能unit-test pass。静态steering越界更少但质量较差，不能把越界指标最小等同系统最优。未检验普通闲聊提取trait向量的跨环境零校准迁移。
new_direct_evidence.comparison: 比TACT更直接聚焦组织role/权限分工；TACT轴来自OT/OA失败trace，DRAS write轴来自role指令，read detector才来自trace。与用户role–trait关系问题紧邻但未分解role为trait组合。

new_direct_evidence.title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
new_direct_evidence.task_endpoints: EverMemBench2400QA；AMemGym1000 on-policy episodes×30–100 turns；ToolACE500 dialogues×2–6 calls的AST/argument/chain匹配；ALARA115文件/web/scripting/scoping任务；App.A4 LIBERO wrapper中OpenVLA执行7DoF环境动作。
new_direct_evidence.intervention: 对task、role、state文本hidden states分别SVD成rank5–30 anchors；不强制正交，PSD kernel累加重叠，逐token用(I+αK)h谱放大并norm rescale；state谱随novelty/decay更新。每agent本模型各建子空间，无跨模型裸向量传送。
new_direct_evidence.major_result: role consistency93.5%，perturbation success比A-MEM高10.7–12.1点；joint span消融−7.2点、matched-rank random−0.8。
new_direct_evidence.scope_and_limits: 截至Nov3新文，直接占据task-role-state共同子空间+动态长期agent稳定的方案空间。ToolACE主要是预测调用结构匹配，不宜把所有工具分支都称真实API执行；真正环境证据尤其AMemGym/ALARA/LIBERO。ActAdd/SEA只steer三个role，而ATLAS steer全部role，比较非同干预覆盖；故部分收益有coverage混杂。
new_direct_evidence.comparison: 不再能把“context-aware agentic subspace/联合role-state steering”笼统称空白。仍未比较self-report/role/behavior三范式matched directions，也未验证conversational persona向量对行动的独立跨任务因果迁移。

new_direct_evidence.title: Controlling Large Language Model Agents with Entropic Activation Steering
new_direct_evidence.task_endpoints: Gaussian两臂bandit：每轮输出parse成arm choice，环境采样reward回传，再续下一轮；测action entropy/有效格式与长期探索。不是只报告选择概率，也不是复杂web/coding。
new_direct_evidence.intervention: EAST从logged environment interaction取decision前激活，run内中心化，以采样估计的action entropy作连续权重求steering向量；新run逐生成token加向量。
new_direct_evidence.major_result: 提高高层action探索/熵同时保留可parse输出，能跨等价但文本重述的任务变体转移；token temperature不足以复现。
new_direct_evidence.scope_and_limits: 2024已有trace-based连续行为信号抽方向与真实反馈环控制。任务仅简化bandit、非BigFive/角色身份、非多阶段工具agent；跨变体共享决策结构，非任意任务迁移。
new_direct_evidence.comparison: 对用户trace extraction不是空白的重要早期基线；与TACT按失败标签差分不同，是entropy-weighted回归式读出/写入。

new_adjacent_evidence.title: Multi-LLM Systems Exhibit Robust Semantic Collapse
new_adjacent_evidence.locations: PDF pp.1–4/16；Supplementary Note3.6 pp.72–74（PDF页索引71起）
new_adjacent_evidence.task_endpoints: 200–1000轮自由多LLM闭环生成的semantic diversity/lexical diversity；无外部任务或工具环境。
new_adjacent_evidence.intervention: Llama3-8B，Anthropic NLP-survey2000 paired answers提sycophancy均值差、300 heldout选layer20/α−10；在200轮三seed交互中抑制迎合。
new_adjacent_evidence.finding: 短评测迎合log-prob bias下降约58%，但未恢复长程semantic diversity，说明控制trait不保证群体动力学指标改善。
new_adjacent_evidence.scope_and_limits: 这是conversational trait steering向多agent交互结果的直接负证据，但不是工具行动控制；仅被测sycophancy方向/剂量不能否定所有persona稳定策略。

new_adjacent_evidence.title: ATC: Agent Trajectory Control for Role-Contract Enforcement in Black-Box Multi-Agent Systems
new_adjacent_evidence.task_endpoints: 角色contract违约、任务表现、role consistency；本轮未细核全部benchmark工具执行协议。
new_adjacent_evidence.intervention: 按输出message评估越角色/权限/逻辑contract，再约束重生成并复核；黑盒text层而非hidden activation。
new_adjacent_evidence.scope_and_limits: ATLAS同作者同期output-layer强对照；不属于persona向量证据，待任务范围核对后可作为等计算budget对照。

new_adjacent_evidence.title: Activation-Steered Personas in Task-Oriented LLM Agent Simulations
new_adjacent_evidence.task_endpoints: SGD Restaurants/Movies双agent模拟；API方法和槽位匹配、inform、completion及judge质量；不将这些指标泛化为开放长程工具执行。
new_adjacent_evidence.intervention: 公开PERSONA向量；user固定单trait，system每轮predict-then-steer组合；L20；Qwen2.5-7B及Llama3.1-8B。
new_adjacent_evidence.scope_and_limits: 用户提供18页PDF后核实；旧候选OpenReview ID有拼写差异，现统一RBI5BjsREi。Qwen US+SA任务指标差异未显著，judge真实性和满意度改善；不是2608.18085v2。

feasible_gaps: 不要主张首次agentic steering或首次trace-based extraction：EAST/TACT/AA43已做；不要笼统首次role-state joint subspace：ATLAS已新发表。
核心可转为跨提取范式的因果迁移矩阵：v_self,v_role,v_trace在同checkpoint、同任务/时间位置、matched norm/compute下分别read/write，测style、strategy、tool format、unsafe actions与success。
几何模型比较global rank1/global rankk/context-local，应额外检验几何能否预测heldout真实动作effect，而非只predict trait表达或在同任务拟合。
在DRAS/ATLAS/TACT强baseline上做机制问题：同一个role加强、其对应trait削弱的冲突干预，或只动planning/self-report而不动action，测试可分离性。
做真实环境反馈事件级实验（工具失败/外部文档/状态更新），匹配context长度和distractor，观察变化来源是局部语义旋转、阈值、默认吸引还是write窗口移动。
critical_scope_checks: AA01 global-workspace §7只测既有agent轨迹末端summary诚实；不可计作在线工具行为被改善。
AA30的agentic九traits只是judge-rated响应场景；AA14删除按钮只描述性选择；AA42 trust/Axis分支是候选likelihood；这些都不可粗略归真工具执行。
训练方法在表中training-only标签意为行为干预安装在训练期，仍有inference evaluation；不意为纯训练曲线无行为验证。

architecture_search.question: Persona/role/trait activation representations across dense, MoE, hybrid, sparse-subnetwork and looped/recurrent architectures
architecture_search.workflow: Coordinator confirmed safe git pull --ff-only already completed; worker read-only canonical, evidence output only in /tmp; no model workloads.
executive_assessment: “persona vector只在dense上做过”已不成立：已有persona任务的MoE/hybrid实测；最新Style Modulation Heads附录还直接steer MoE attention heads。
架构特异因果问题已有强prior：RARE隔离representation edit与router drift，SteerMoE/MASCing直接改expert routing，MoE Personalization论文做crosscoder和专家干预。
跨模型dense/MoE性能差异通常仍混入训练、规模、tokenizer和后训练；即使active/total params匹配也不是architecture随机化实验。最有价值是within-checkpoint的router/模块/path对照。
persona weight pruning、少数原生neurons steering、SAE sparse latent steering、MoE top-k计算与token-dependent activation sparsity是五种不同“稀疏”。
looped models已有frozen-loop state steering与attention patching，亦有非官方persona-vector探索代码；本轮未核到系统persona/role/behavior三范式的loop-specific因果研究，不能宣称全领域无人做。

categories.1_tested_on_architecture: 模型面板含MoE/hybrid，行为/方向结果可证该checkpoint有效；不识别架构本身导致差异。
categories.2_controlled_architecture_mechanism: 同checkpoint内控制router/path/读写site等模块变量，或配对训练只改架构；本轮强例为前者，未找到严格配对同数据训练的persona dense-vs-MoE因果研究。
categories.3_expert_router_specific: 直接干预router logits、专家selection/output或router-invisible subspace，不与普通residual addition混称。
categories.4_sparsity_distinctions: 参数mask剪枝≠保留weights而改少数neuron activation≠SAE latent稀疏编码≠MoE native top-k≠为加速skip neurons的dynamic activation sparsity。
categories.5_recurrence: token维递归SSM/RWKV与depth维复用同Transformer blocks是不同 recurrence；Gemma3 local/global attention也不是Qwen3.5 GatedDeltaNet、更不是Mamba。

literature.title: Steering at the Source: Style Modulation Heads for Robust Persona Control
literature.actual_models: Main Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama3.1-8B-Instruct; App.F gemma-3-12b-it, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507.
literature.validated_intervention: App.F layer-wise attention-output steering and selected-head steering with trait/coherency outcomes; Qwen layers27/32/39 and heads10/22, Gemma L24 heads2/7/8 described. Not merely probing.
literature.finding: Style heads also function in MoE and dense local/global-attention models; geometric transition less sharply localizes layer, effects spread across several layers.
literature.boundary: No trained-matched architecture manipulation; differences can reflect size/norm/training. MoE experiments target attention heads, not expert/router mediation.
literature.locator: App.F.1/F.2 Figs19–22, App.F.3; official v2 28 May2026.

literature.title: TACT: Mitigating Overthinking and Overacting in Coding Agents via Activation Steering
literature.actual_models: Qwen3.5-27B dense linear/full attention hybrid; Gemma4-26B-A4B-it MoE (retain exact config verification before arch claims).
literature.validated_intervention: Boundary residual OT/OA axis Add/Cap/Gate in SWE-bench Verified, Terminal-Bench2, CLAW-Eval real tools.
literature.boundary: Validates axes on two structures, not a dense-vs-MoE controlled mechanism test and not conversational persona-vector transfer.

literature.title: Probing Persona-Dependent Preferences in Language Models
literature.actual_models: Gemma3-27B dense versus Qwen3.5-122B-A10B MoE hybrid, text-only experiments.
literature.validated_intervention: Cross-persona preference readout; strong Gemma choice steering, Qwen pilot did not reproduce same control.
literature.boundary: Read/write/model discrepancy is real evidence boundary, not proof MoE routing causes it; scale, family, training and intervention calibration differ.

literature.title: Persona Matters: Effects of Activation Steering on Short Answer Generation and Scoring
literature.validated_intervention: Seven trait vectors on ASAP-SAS answer generation and scoring, task/rubric outcomes.
literature.finding: Reports substantially larger scorer calibration shifts for gpt-oss than Qwen; ELA more sensitive than science.
literature.boundary: Three checkpoint comparison, no architecture-only causal effect; educational scoring calibration not agentic behavioral coherence.

literature.title: Explaining the Roles of Experts in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs for Personalization
literature.actual_models: OLMoE-1B-7B(0125), Qwen3-30B-A3B(2507), Mixtral8x7B; active/total matched dense references OLMo2, Qwen2.5 and Llama2.
literature.validated_intervention: Router then expert fine-tuning on Multifaceted Collection (style, background knowledge, informativeness, harmlessness); crosscoder latent patching; boost persona-aligned expert logits versus random same-size experts, measure KL to personalized model.
literature.finding: Personalization features align with stable expert sets and causal routing manipulations move output toward adapted counterpart.
literature.boundary: One selected layer/model, dense controls differ in training; KL movement toward counterpart is narrower than all real behavior improvement. Paper limitations contain troubling wording selection on test data; verify split code before adopting evidence as rigorous unbiased localization.

literature.title: RARE: Decoupling Representation Steering from Expert Routing in Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
literature.relevance: adjacent representation steering; directly important architecture mechanism
literature.actual_models: DeepSeekV2-Lite-Chat, Mixtral8x7B, Phi3.5-MoE, Phi-mini-MoE, Qwen3-30B-A3B-2507, GPT-oss20b.
literature.validated_intervention: Compare clean routing retention; project edits into router-matrix nullspace and correct downstream propagated routing drift. Five direction estimators; harmfulness, TruthfulQA and CounterFact.
literature.finding: Router preservation can recover effective steering, routing more content-sensitive than behavioral under matched-content probes.
literature.boundary: Not persona-specific role/trait geometry or full read–write dissociation. Cannot claim any role change should preserve routing; target behaviors and task semantics may sometimes require new experts.

literature.title: Steering MoE LLMs via Expert (De)Activation / SteerMoE
literature.validated_intervention: Rank expert activation frequency differences under paired opposite behaviors, promote/suppress router selections at inference. Six MoEs, 11 safety/faithfulness benchmarks.
literature.boundary: Behavior-associated experts and causal efficacy do not establish pure one-expert-one-persona; safety/refusal and RAG faithfulness not equivalent to human trait structure.

literature.title: MASCing: Configurable Mixture-of-Experts Behavior via Activation Steering Masks
literature.actual_models: Seven MoEs incl DeepSeekMoE16B, gpt-oss20B, HunyuanA13B, Mixtral, Phi3.5, Qwen1.5MoE and Qwen3-30B-A3B.
literature.validated_intervention: LSTM surrogate over router-logit sequences to form routing masks; runtime router score modification for multi-turn jailbreak defense and content policy boundary setting.
literature.boundary: Not a generic persona direction and not weight pruning. Requires behavior-specific mask construction; expert routing intervention can affect normal utility.
literature.locator: §4 framework, §5.2 models, §6.5 activation vs expert steering.

literature.title: PersonaFuse: A Situation-Aware Post-Training Framework for Adaptive LLM Behavior in Enterprise Tasks
literature.validated_intervention: Ten high/low Big-Five LoRA experts with learned query/persona router; warmup expert→train router→joint training; enterprise workflows.
literature.boundary: Persona-MoE is deliberately added personality-specific adapter mixture, not discovery of natural semantic experts in native MoE nor evidence a persona is linearly decomposed in an untouched model.

literature.title: Your Language Model Secretly Contains Personality Subnetworks
literature.validated_intervention: Activation-guided/contrastive weight masks in dense Llama2/3/Qwen2.5; MBTI, AI persona and RoleAgentBench; switch fixed masks.
literature.boundary: Static sparse weight subnetwork != token-varying sparse activation. Reduced nonzero count does not alone establish GPU latency gain without sparse kernels. Not native MoE.

literature.title: Small sets of neurons reproduce persona vector steering, and the neuron basis is privileged
literature.publication_type: Original-author technical blog / MATS side project, 31 Oct2026; not peer-reviewed paper
literature.actual_models: Qwen3-8B, 275 Assistant Axis roles; top neuron contributions through layer18.
literature.validated_intervention: Steer top100 MLP neurons at original layers with matched total strength versus random rotated bases/PC/random neurons; judge identity probe replies.
literature.finding: At4x strength, top100 about64% role-trait replies vs69% full vector,11% rotated basis.
literature.boundary: Role identity prompts/short replies, not broad decisions; only one model. Sufficiency under amplified edits not necessity at natural activation; large removal confounded. Sparse set of edited neurons is not skipped computation or inferred speedup.

literature.title: Steering Large Language Model Activations in Sparse Spaces / SAS
literature.validated_intervention: Contrastively select sparse latent dimensions on Gemma2, steering/composition versus dense vectors.
literature.boundary: Sparse feature coordinates/SAE encoding do not imply sparse base model weights or sparse inference execution.

literature.title: Locating and Steering Refusal Beyond Attention
literature.relevance: adjacent refusal plus roleplay-attack persona suppression
literature.validated_intervention: Architecture-specific fresh-write-site refusal read/steer; rigid-rotation transported direction ablation; projection gate; App.A.14–A.20 two-direction roleplay refusal/persona controls.
literature.finding: Decodable residual/SSM state need not control refusal; fresh write-site directions do. Two-direction persona fix differs or fails on RWKV/Zamba.
literature.boundary: Cannot claim SSM persona steering entirely unexplored; however refusal/jailbreak persona direction is not full self-report/role/strategy phenotype. Multiple model/training factors remain in cross-architecture contrasts.

literature.title: Shared Weights, Selected Computations: How Looped Transformers Route What Each Loop Does
literature.actual_models: Small looped graph/parity models, Ouro2.6B task-finetuned.
literature.validated_intervention: Frozen backbone plus learned linear/low-rank state map J; one/two-hop graph transition, language letter-walk; attention-pattern/output patching and matched intermediate-supervision training pairs.
literature.boundary: Already demonstrates loop-dependent state steering and causal attention routing, but not persona identity/trait/behavior. Long composition degrades; short controller success not persistent agent guarantee. Does not prove a rank1 persona vector is constant across loops.

literature.title: Scaling Latent Reasoning via Looped Language Models / Ouro
literature.relevance: official architecture/model access, not persona paper
literature.config_verified: OuroForCausalLM; num_hidden_layers24; total_ut_steps4; hidden2048; all24 layer_types full_attention; official config downloaded read-only. Thinking checkpoint same layer/loop defaults.
literature.boundary: Physical layer index and effective loop depth must both be logged; an all-loop hook edits same module repeatedly, changing total dose. Variable loop budget changes computation, not interchangeable with CoT tokens.

literature.title: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation
literature.relevance: official looped architecture, not persona evidence
literature.validated_intervention: Time/step-size conditioned shared blocks with shortcut-consistency training and variable test-time budgets; language modeling/reasoning.
literature.boundary: No persona term found in official primary HTML in this search. chengyh23/loopformer is a fork despite README repeating official boilerplate; persona extraction scripts there only establish exploratory code exists, not official published validated persona results.

existing_architecture_summary: Original46 includes GPT-oss20B in ID26/27, MoE/hybrid Qwen3.5 in ID9, dense hybrid Qwen3.5 in ID30/44, dense-pruned ID22 and non-Transformer GRU world model ID10. These are heterogeneous evidence roles, not a single controlled architecture result.

Assistant Axis AA06 adds real-tool intervention on dense hybrid and MoE; AA07 preference read/write negative MoE result should not be erased; AA30 53-trait natural/steerable map compares Qwen3-8B vs gpt-oss20B but no router intervention.

Qwen3.5-9B/27B configs are qwen3_5_text dense GatedDeltaNet/full attention, not MoE despite family-level model-card marketing; Qwen3.5-122B-A10B is separate MoE checkpoint. Gemma3 local/global attention not Mamba.

id23_update_proposal.action: coordinator-only; append latest official evidence, preserve older scope provenance; worker does not edit canonical
id23_update_proposal.version: 2603.13249v2, 28 May2026; latest abs page and HTML header verified
id23_update_proposal.new_models_studied: Main: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct; Llama3.1-8B-Instruct. App.F actual steering: google/gemma-3-12b-it; Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507.
id23_update_proposal.architecture: Main dense GQA; added Gemma3 dense VLM-capable local/global attention text experiment; added Qwen3 MoE Transformer. Qwen3 config qwen3_moe,128experts/top8,48blocks; no expert/router intervention, target attention output/heads.
id23_update_proposal.inference_mode: Paper App.F does not report a thinking toggle or compare reasoning modes. Exact suffix Instruct-2507 itself is non-thinking checkpoint per official model card; retain distinction support vs experiment. Gemma3 no dedicated thinking comparison. All reported prompts text-only.
evidence_locations: App.F.2 Figs21/22 actual MoE attention/head steering
id23_update_proposal.boundary: Not just probe, but not matched architecture causal ablation; claims of why localization broadens are authors interpretations, not isolated tests.

novelty_boundaries: 不宜写：首次persona steering用于MoE；首次router-specific behavioral control；首次looped state steering；首次少数neurons实现persona；首次SSM上的persona/拒绝控制。
可检验而尚不能据本次检索认定独创：同一role/trait在dense与MoE的self-report/linguistic/decision三终点read–write gap是否由route changes而非content造成；需对照RARE及personalization专家实验。
loop更清楚的问题：共享physical block跨loop的persona方向，是固定rank1可迁移、不同强度足够、还是需要loop-specific directions；并检验行为选择性与剂量归一化，而不只画cosine。
稀疏更清楚的问题：在相同有效norm和能力约束下，native-neuron、SAE、expert和dense-vector干预对风格/策略的选择性是否不同；Mayner已覆盖单模型role identity的sparse sufficiency，必须增加新终点与对照。

minimal_viable_design.preferred_first_track: 先在一个可控MoE checkpoint内隔离routing介导，再做dense跨模型复制；比“架构榜单”更易产生因果结论。
minimal_viable_design.panel: 资源小：OLMoE1B-7B-Instruct配OLMo2-1B/7B仅作参照；资源足：Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507配Qwen3-8B/32B，但解释为matched-family/size references而非architecture-only causal。另单独Ouro1.4B loop实验，不强行合成一个architecture变量。
controls: 固定题目/trait definitions/提取训练量，dev选层与dose后锁定test
same-checkpoint条件：native residual direction、router-nullspace(RARE式)、clean router replay或route freeze、router-only edit、post-router expert-output edit
norm matched random、label shuffle、negative alpha、direction strength grid with coherence/capability filters
matched topic/content下self-report/role-play/decision各抽方向；全部3x3 transfer matrix与unsteered readout比较
读取router topk/JSD、expert-output contribution、target/offtarget outcome；cosine只是几何协变量
Ouro hooks记录physical layer×loop×prefill/decode，不把相同hook调用4次当一次；single-loop vs all-loop dose normalize，swap directions across loops，并测末态/行为效果
minimal_viable_design.metrics: target behavior, self-report, style, off-target traits, factual/decision quality, coherence, refusal/invalid, latency and token/loop cost. Optional small real-tool task only after decision baseline reproducible.
minimal_viable_design.architecture_causality_limit: 若要把结论归因架构本身，须训练同数据/预算的dense vs MoE或shared vs unshared小模型，或至少factorial ablation with matched initialization/streams；现成checkpoint不能消除recipe混杂。

access_and_compute_dependencies: 需open weights/config、router pre/post logits与expert outputs hooks；API模型无法进行主因果测试。优先HF/eager reference implementation确认hook正确，fused MoE/SSM kernels可能隐藏中间态。
MoE active params不等于显存：Qwen30B BF16权重约60GB(估算，不含KV/activation/runtime)，OLMoE7B约14GB，dense8B约16GB；必须按真实checkpoint dtype/quantization与GPU测峰值，不宣称某卡必能装。
Ouro1.4B BF16约2.8GB权重，但4loop有效深度/缓存和activation记录放大成本；官方trust_remote_code和cache行为要冻结revision并检查loop indexing。
提取只缓存少数层/位置的在线均值和必要router统计，避免全token×expert×层长trace内存；clean-reference correction可能要求额外forward，计算成本单独报。
不需先训练SAE/crosscoder；native contrastive vector＋router controls先做。若要复现personalization crosscoder或多个大模型全量trace则需显著额外GPU/存储与训练预算。
本轮未检查用户现有GPU allocation，也未申请/运行模型；最终规模和资源使用需root依现有授权及HPC规则确定。

rows: PERSONA / Persona-Flow（ID7）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15669
Combines persona directions as dialogue context changes and controls expression; tool actions and task completion were not tested.
Big Five personality control + multi-trait composition and dynamic steering
Yes; ten Big Five trait-pole persona vectors, composed by context
PersonalityBench; contextualized BFI-44; Persona-Evolve (800 scenarios)
Prompt-Activation Duality / GCAD（ID42）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10664
Maintains persona expression and reduces coherence loss over ten dialogue turns; long-term intervention must account for cache accumulation. Agent execution was not tested.
Multi-turn persona control + reducing coherence loss from KV-cache accumulation
Yes; control signals derived from the attention contribution of persona system prompts (GCAD)
15 traits × 10 dialogue turns with persistent KV cache
PersonaSteer
https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-emnlp.1270/
Learns steering signals from history and improves personalization as dialogue progresses; evaluates multi-turn alignment rather than tool-task completion.
Personalized alignment＋learnable activation steering
Yes; high-dimensional steering vectors learned from interaction history, not fixed Big Five axes
ALOE; Extended ALOE (OOD tests built with PersonaChat profiles)
Emotion Concepts and their Function in a Large Language Model（ID4）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07729
Increasing desperation or reducing calm increases coding reward hacking; stronger emotion may change the strategy rather than monotonically amplify the original behavior.
Effects of emotion steering on agent reward hacking, blackmail, and related decisions
Yes; emotion vectors such as desperation, calm, and anger
Seven author-constructed coding reward-hacking tasks and blackmail scenarios
How Emotion Shapes the Behavior of LLMs and Agents / E-STEER（ID29）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.00005
Preferred emotion strengths differ between planning, answer selection, and execution; optimizing one module does not maximize whole-agent success.
Effects of emotion steering on planning, selection, and execution capabilities
Yes; VAD emotion directions using features selected in SAE space
HotpotQA；Scientific；GAIA
Impatient Users Confuse AI Agents（ID19）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.04491
Changing only the user simulator’s impatience and related traits can reduce target-agent success; the hardest traits depend on model and domain.
Persona-steered user simulation + agent robustness evaluation
Yes; impatience, skepticism, confusion, and incoherence directions in the user simulator
τ-Trait: airline, retail, telecom, and telemedicine; BFCL multi-turn calls
TACT（AA06）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.05980
Intervening on overthinking / overacting directions at the end of reasoning improves task completion and reduces steps; experiments cover dense and MoE models.
Reducing agent overthinking / overacting + steering at the thinking–action boundary
Yes; two behavioral directions contrasting overthinking / overacting with calibrated steps
SWE-bench Verified；Terminal-Bench 2.0；CLAW-Eval
Mitigating Reward Hacking in Realistic Scenarios Through Representation Engineering（AA43）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29129
Directions extracted from trajectories and other sources reduce tool-based reward hacking; original-task solve rates must also be checked to distinguish improvement from abandonment.
Reducing agent reward hacking + behavioral direction extraction and dynamic capping
Yes; hacking-trace differences, optimized directions, and anti-hacking-spec directions; addition / cap / floor compared
MisTrace; ImpossibleBench; original LiveCodeBench; also School of Reward Hacks
ContextEcho（ID38／AA08）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.24279
Claude Code histories change assistant expression and format compliance; restoring Axis projection in snapshot branches did not restore expression scores.
Observing long-horizon agent persona drift + testing Assistant Axis intervention
Yes; Assistant Axis, limited to snapshot-branch intervention tests
ContextEcho evaluation: three donated Claude Code logs (coding, manuscript writing, and document work) + 25 identity / preference questions; 23 models are test subjects, not datasets
Telling FIBS（AA40）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.12445
Internal readouts detect covert sabotage in tool trajectories, including unspoken behavior; this is monitoring rather than direct agent control.
Monitoring agent deception / sabotage + activation probes
No activation steering; activation probes monitor deception / sabotage
FIBS；SHADE-Arena；BashArena
Social Priors（AA42）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.16946
One agent with antisocial user priors can exhaust a shared resource; Axis control is a separate probability-scoring experiment, not evidence of corrected environment behavior.
Effects of user social priors on agent trust and cooperation + Axis-control tests
Yes; Assistant Axis capping only in the trust-scoring branch, not the GovSim execution branch
GovSim fisheries; matched social-prior corpora; 376-context Axis controls
Mind Your Own Role / DRAS
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.15907
Adjusting role directions according to overstepping risk reduces overstepping and improves software output quality; the static variant with least overstepping is not necessarily best in quality.
Reducing multi-agent role overstepping + dynamic role steering
Yes; activation differences with / without role instructions, with dynamically adjusted strength
ChatDev / MetaGPT; 1,200 SRDD requirements; SWE-Dev for preparation / validation
Drift No More / ATLAS（ID48）
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.04315
Jointly maintaining task, role, and current state improves memory and coordination, including under embodied perturbations; call-structure scores and environment execution are reported separately.
Reducing task / role / state drift + joint-subspace steering
Yes; a joint task / role / state subspace kernel, not a single persona vector
EverMemBench；AMemGym；ToolACE；ALARA；LIBERO
Controlling Large Language Model Agents with Entropic Activation Steering / EAST
https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.00244
Directions extracted from interactions control exploration; token sampling temperature does not reproduce the effect. The environment is a simplified bandit.
Controlling agent exploration + entropy-weighted activation steering
Yes; an exploration direction extracted with action-entropy weighting
Gaussian two-armed bandit and textually rephrased variants
Multi-LLM Systems Exhibit Robust Semantic Collapse
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.17193
Reducing sycophancy in short tests did not restore long-term group semantic diversity; changing a trait behavior does not guarantee improvement in system-level metrics.
Multi-agent semantic-diversity collapse + anti-sycophancy steering tests
Yes; an anti-sycophancy direction tested for mitigating semantic collapse
Author-generated interactions of 200–1,000 turns; 200-turn steering test
Activation-Steered Personas in Task-Oriented LLM Agent Simulations
https://openreview.net/pdf?id=RBI5BjsREi

Persona vectors are injected into both user and system agents. Turn-level system adaptation mainly improves judge-rated truthfulness and satisfaction; task gains are modest and depend on domain, trait, and strength.
Persona control in task-oriented dialogue + fixed user / dynamic system steering
Yes; ten Big Five trait-pole persona vectors; fixed for the user, composed each turn for the system
Schema-Guided Dialogue (SGD): Restaurants, Movies; 50 Baseline–SA dialogue pairs and 2,000 US–US+SA pairs (including α=0)
